job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description: INTOO is a fast-growing HR technology solutions provider seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Software Engineer. This is an individual contributor role with significant ownership over technical execution, system reliability, and architectural direction. You’ll operate across the stack, lead by example, and mentor engineers while driving high-impact initiatives.
responsibilities: Own and deliver complex technical systems and critical workflows end-to-end
Ensure production reliability, performance, and security across the platform
Lead and influence architectural decisions with a focus on long-term maintainability
Communicate complex technical and business concepts effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Mentor and coach engineers at all skill levels
Drive incident response and continuous improvement of system health and processes
Continuously assess industry trends, risks and identify areas for improvement
